name: SKYECHIP
recent: SkyeChip 与法国 SiPearl 签署谅解备忘录，计划成立合资公司并申请新的 ARM CSS 授权，开发下一代 AI 与高性能计算处理器。公司截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度营收环比增长 9.1%，净利环比增长 27.2%。同期，独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai 多次申报在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 与法国 SiPearl 签署谅解备忘录，计划成立合资公司并申请新的 ARM CSS 授权，开发基于 Arm 的下一代计算平台。
截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度营收 5,415.7 万令吉，净利 1,770.6 万令吉。
因员工行使 ESOS 期权，发行 2,000 股新股，于 2026 年 10 月 7 日上市。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报增持股份，包括在闭门期内的交易。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度，营收为 5,415.7 万令吉，环比增长 9.1%；净利为 1,770.6 万令吉，环比增长 27.2%；净利率为 32.7%，高于上一季度的 28.0%。

recent_en: SkyeChip signed an MOU with France's SiPearl to form a joint venture and seek a new ARM CSS license to develop next-generation AI and high-performance computing processors. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 9.1% QoQ and net profit rose 27.2% QoQ. Meanwhile, Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai reported several acquisitions of shares in the open market.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with France's SiPearl to form a joint venture and seek a new ARM CSS license to develop a next-generation Arm-based compute platform.
For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM54.157 million and net profit was RM17.706 million.
Issued 2,000 new shares from the exercise of ESOS options, listed on 7 October 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai reported multiple acquisitions of shares between October and November 2026, including dealings during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM54.157 million, up 9.1% QoQ; net profit was RM17.706 million, up 27.2% QoQ; net margin was 32.7%, higher than 28.0% in the previous quarter.
